item.title: Gum Sweetener Linked to Heart Attacks
item.description:
Gum Sweetener Linked to Heart Attacks

A sugar alcohol at industrial dose

Xylitol is easy to miss because it was designed to be missed. It is the sugar alcohol in gum, toothpaste, jam, yogurt, and ice cream, the ingredient that lets a label say sugar-free without tasting like a punishment. It occurs in plants in tiny amounts. That is not how people now encounter it. It is being added at doses about 1,000 times what appears in nature.
